home.aboutTitle: From our kitchen to your table
home.aboutText: Kebabish was founded in Hoogkarspel with one goal: bringing the authentic flavors of Pakistan to West Friesland. Every dish is made fresh with care, just like at home.
home.why1Text: No ready-made meals — everything is prepared fresh every day.
home.why2Text: Traditional recipes and spices, just like home cooking.
home.why4Text: Through the website or straight via WhatsApp — whatever suits you.

home.deliveryText: Including Bovenkarspel, Grootebroek, Lutjebroek, Westwoud, Wognum, Wervershoof and Enkhuizen.

faq.q: Can I collect my order myself?
faq.a: No, Kebabish delivers only. There is no restaurant to eat in and no pickup option — we bring everything to your door.

faq.q: Which towns do you deliver to?
faq.a: We deliver within roughly 10 kilometres of Hoogkarspel. The Delivery area page lists exactly which towns that covers, and checkout checks your postcode automatically.

faq.q: How does choosing a delivery time work?
faq.a: You pick a delivery window yourself at checkout. Each window has a limited number of places, so the kitchen never gets flooded and your order really does arrive inside that slot. You can also order a few days ahead, which helps if you are planning something.
You pay online through our payment partner Mollie, using iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Klarna. Prefer to order over WhatsApp? That works too — we then arrange payment between us.

faq.q: Is there a delivery fee or a minimum order?
faq.a: Any delivery fee and minimum order value are always shown in your basket and at checkout, before you pay. Nothing is ever added that you have not seen the amount of first.

faq.q: I have an allergy. Where can I see the details?
faq.a: Every dish lists which of the 14 legally declarable allergens it may contain. If you are unsure, or your allergy is severe, contact us before you order and we will go through it with you.

faq.q: Can I still cancel or change my order?
faq.a: Contact us as soon as possible over WhatsApp or by phone. Once we have started cooking we can no longer cancel an order — it is freshly prepared food.

faq.q: Do I need an account to order?
faq.a: No, you can check out as a guest. An account does save your delivery address and order history, so your next order takes a few taps less.

faq.q: Do you handle larger orders or catering?
faq.a: Yes. For parties, company drinks and family gatherings we are happy to put something together. Get in touch over WhatsApp or take a look at our catering page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Kebabish takes protecting your personal data seriously. This privacy policy explains what data we collect, why, and what rights you have.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: This website, kebabish.nl, is operated by Marfah Enterprise, trading as Kebabish, located at De Overstoep 49, 1616RK Hoogkarspel, and registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KVK) under number 42147417.
For any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, contact us at info@kebabish.nl or +31 6 84011572.

sections.heading: What data we collect
body: Depending on how you use our services, we process the following data:
list: Name, email address, phone number, delivery address and chosen delivery time when placing an order
Order history and the contents of your order
Account details if you create a customer account (name, email, password stored in encrypted form)
Your delivery address, only if you choose to save it for next time — you can remove it from your account page
Your consent to receive news and offers by email, with the date and where you gave it — it is off by default and you can withdraw it at any time
Communication via WhatsApp, phone or email when you contact us
Technical data such as IP address and browser type, for website security and functionality

Your feedback (your answers and any comment), linked to your order if you open the form from the link in your email, your account or your order page. We only keep your name and email address with it if you tell us we may contact you

sections.heading: Why we use this data
body: We use your data only to:
list: Process, deliver and handle your order
Contact you about your order
Offer a customer account and order history, if you choose to create one
Meet legal obligations, such as our tax record-keeping
Keep our website secure and technically sound
Read and use feedback to improve our food, delivery and website and — only if you have allowed it — to contact you or show your comment (first name only) on our website

sections.heading: Legal basis
body: We process your data based on the performance of a contract (placing and delivering your order), a legal obligation (such as our bookkeeping duties), or our legitimate interest in a secure, well-functioning website.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
body: We never sell your data to third parties. To provide our service, we share data with a small number of carefully chosen partners:
list: Mollie, to securely process online payments — we never store payment details such as card numbers ourselves
PDOK (the Dutch government's geodata platform), to look up your address from your postcode
Google Maps, to show the map of our delivery area
Resend, to send order-related emails
Our hosting and database providers (Vercel and Supabase), who act solely as processors on our behalf

sections.heading: Required and optional information
body: To place an order your name, email address, phone number, delivery address and chosen delivery time are required: without them we can't confirm or deliver your order.
Optional are: a note with your order, a customer account (and your phone number in it), a saved delivery address and your consent to receive news and offers. You can always order without these.

sections.heading: Where your data is processed
body: Our database is hosted by Supabase in Ireland (European Union) and our website runs on Vercel in the Dublin (Ireland) region.

Some of our providers are US companies or use US systems, including Vercel, Resend (email) and Google (map). Where this means personal data ends up outside the European Economic Area, it is done on the basis of a European Commission adequacy decision (the EU-US Data Privacy Framework) or the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, as set out in our data processing agreements with these providers.

sections.heading: Retention period
body: We do not keep your data longer than necessary for the purpose it was collected for. Order data and invoices we need for our tax records are kept for 7 years, as Dutch tax rules require of us as a business. Other personal data is not kept longer than its purpose requires.
We keep feedback for as long as it helps us improve Kebabish; we delete yours sooner if you ask us to.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: We currently do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies. Your shopping cart is stored locally in your browser so it's kept between visits — this data never leaves your own device.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to:
list: Access the data we hold about you
Have inaccurate data corrected
Have your data deleted, where legally possible
Have the processing of your data restricted, and object to certain processing
Receive your data in a commonly used format (data portability), where applicable
Withdraw any consent you have given, at any time
Lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens)
sections.footer: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@kebabish.nl.

sections.heading: Automated decision-making
body: We do not make decisions based solely on automated processing that have legal effects on you or similarly significantly affect you.

sections.heading: Security
body: We take appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against loss or unauthorised use.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. The most current version is always available on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms and conditions apply to every order you place with Kebabish, whether through the website or via WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Who we are
body: Kebabish is the trading name of Marfah Enterprise, located at De Overstoep 49, 1616RK Hoogkarspel, registered with the Dutch Chamber of Commerce (KVK) under number 42147417. You can reach us at info@kebabish.nl and +31 6 84011572.

sections.heading: Orders
body: An order is only concluded once we've confirmed it via the website or WhatsApp. You're responsible for providing an accurate delivery address and contact details.

sections.heading: Prices and payment
body: All prices on the website are in euros and include VAT. Any delivery fee and minimum order amount are shown clearly before you check out.
Online orders are paid for in advance through our payment partner Mollie (iDEAL, credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or Klarna). Orders placed via WhatsApp are arranged directly with us.

sections.heading: Delivery
body: Kebabish offers delivery only — there is no option to dine in or collect your order in person. We deliver within our stated delivery area around Hoogkarspel; unfortunately we're unable to deliver outside it.
Stated delivery times are an estimate, not a guarantee — for example during busy periods or in poor weather.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
body: Because we prepare fresh food that spoils quickly, the standard 14-day right of withdrawal that normally applies to online purchases does not apply to our orders once confirmed, under the statutory exception in the Dutch Civil Code (Article 6:230p BW) for perishable goods.

sections.heading: Cancellations
body: Need to cancel an order? Contact us as soon as possible. Once we've started preparing your order, we're unfortunately no longer able to cancel it.

sections.heading: Allergens and food safety
body: Our dishes indicate which of the 14 legally declarable allergens they may contain. If you have an allergy or food intolerance, please contact us before ordering so we can advise you properly.

sections.heading: Liability
body: Our liability is limited to direct damages and to a maximum of the value of the relevant order, except in cases of intent or gross negligence. We are not liable for delays or failure to meet our obligations due to circumstances beyond our control.

sections.heading: Complaints
body: Not happy with your order? Let us know as soon as possible at info@kebabish.nl or +31 6 84011572, so we can work out a solution together.

sections.heading: Governing law
body: These terms and conditions are governed by Dutch law. Disputes will be submitted to the competent court in the Netherlands.

sections.heading: Changes
body: We may update these terms and conditions from time to time. The most current version is always available on this page.
